title: BlueSky PRO Multi-UAV Negative and Regression Fixtures

fixtures.name: 4D insufficient separation
fixtures.principle: 2D/temporal proximity with insufficient required separation must be classified as CONFLICT.

fixtures.name: Uncertainty prevents proof
fixtures.principle: When uncertainty prevents demonstration of required separation, the result is UNRESOLVED and release is blocked.

fixtures.name: Minimum feasible temporal correction
fixtures.principle: A deterministic temporal correction in the inclusive 0–5 second range may resolve a conflict if fleet-wide re-verification passes.

fixtures.name: Correction creates secondary conflict
fixtures.principle: A locally successful correction is rejected when fleet-wide re-verification creates another conflict.

fixtures.name: No permitted correction
fixtures.principle: If no permitted spatial, temporal or vertical correction satisfies all constraints, the mission remains blocked.

fixtures.name: Route change invalidates downstream PASS
fixtures.principle: Changing RouteSet invalidates performance, trajectory, conflict and final-check results derived from the previous route version.

fixtures.name: Performance change invalidates trajectory/conflict
fixtures.principle: A change in wind/performance/timing invalidates trajectory and all downstream conflict/final results.

fixtures.name: UAV configuration/readiness change
fixtures.principle: A relevant UAV configuration or readiness change invalidates affected assignment, performance, trajectory, conflict and final checks.

fixtures.name: Deterministic replay
fixtures.principle: Identical mission inputs, source versions, configuration and algorithm versions produce the same planning state and verification result.

fixtures.name: Version mismatch at final gate
fixtures.principle: Final verification must reject a result whose linked artifact versions are inconsistent.

fixtures.name: Technical release does not equal authorization
fixtures.principle: RELEASE_ELIGIBLE is a technical planning result and cannot be interpreted as regulatory authorization.
